clips.title: The story
paras: Across Mulgore, Plainstrider Scale is sought for a remedy Maur Raincaller prepares in Bloodhoof Village. The tough scale helps counter a spreading infection.
Plainstriders roam Mulgore with tough scales covering their powerful legs. The scales protect them, though only some are firm enough to grind for folk remedies.
